title: fix(layout,app-shell): in the icon-mode sidebar a hidden group label no longer takes the click on the row above it (objectui#12744)
body:
Fixes #12744
Clause-②: no (a class at the call sites; if the fix adds an exported wrapper to `@object-ui/components`, the dev reads the built declaration closure and this line is corrected)

## What was wrong

In the collapsed (icon-mode) sidebar, the `SidebarGroupLabel` primitive hides a label with `opacity-0` and `-mt-8` and nothing else. The invisible label stays hit-testable. `-mt-8` moves it over the lower half of the row just above its group, and `opacity-0` makes it a stacking context that paints, and hit-tests, above that row. So a centre click on that row's icon landed on the label:

- a collapsible group's label (an `asChild` button) toggled its group;
- the Recent label (a div with a click handler) toggled Recent;
- either way the row did not navigate.

A note on the card's wording: the label covers the row **above** its group, not the group's first item. In the stock showcase that row is the top-level Page Authoring, under the Workspace group's label. The card's own evidence (Page Authoring's centre hits the Workspace label) is the same reading.

## The fix

The labels measured to intercept now carry `group-data-[state=collapsed]:group-data-[collapsible=icon]:pointer-events-none`. That variant is the primitive's own hiding condition, so a label stops taking pointer events exactly while it is hidden. It rides on the `className` each call site passes; `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` is Shadcn-synced and is not touched (AGENTS.md #7).

- `@object-ui/layout`, `NavigationRenderer`: the collapsible group label, and the Favorites label.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`, `UnifiedSidebar`: the Recent label.

The class sits in one module-local constant per file. It is not exported: both files are re-exported whole by their package entries. `cn` keeps the class, because the primitive sets no `pointer-events` class (hypothesis 2). The pins read it on the rendered class list of the real primitive, and the browser reads computed `pointer-events: none` (below).

The expanded sidebar is unchanged: a group's label still toggles its group by mouse and keyboard, and the Recent label still opens and closes Recent. Nothing is added to either package entry.

### Which call sites intercept (hypothesis 1, measured)

Every `SidebarGroupLabel` outside `ui/**` is hit-testable while hidden. It intercepts only when a row sits directly above its group inside the same sidebar content.

| Call site | Label | Intercepts in the console? | Done here |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NavigationRenderer`, collapsible group | `asChild` button | yes: every group below a row (showcase readings A and B, reading C's People group) | fixed |
| `NavigationRenderer`, Favorites | div | yes, under the Area switcher of a multi-area app: it covered the Money area row (reading C) | fixed |
| `UnifiedSidebar`, Recent | div with a click handler | yes: the last row of the navigation above it (readings B and C) | fixed |
| `UnifiedSidebar`, Area | div | no: first in the content; the context selectors above it hide when collapsed. Reading C: the Work row has 0/31 dead rows | left |
| `UnifiedSidebar`, Starred (home arm) | div | not reachable: no console route mounts the home arm (see Acceptance notes) | left |
| `AppSchemaRenderer`, `AreaSwitcher` | div | not measured in a browser: the console does not mount `AppSchemaRenderer`. Its label is first in its content, the same position as `UnifiedSidebar`'s Area label. Its `NavigationRenderer` labels get this fix | left |

`SidebarNav` (`@object-ui/layout`) also renders `SidebarGroupLabel`. It is not on the claim's file surface, and the repo has no mount of it (Acceptance notes).

### Shape 3: a shared fix was considered, not taken

The one fix shared by every call site that needs no `ui/**` edit and no new export is a plain-CSS rule. It would go in `packages/components/src/sidebar-fixes.css`, the sidebar override sheet `src/index.ts` already imports, keyed on `[data-sidebar="group-label"]` under the collapsed icon `.group`. It was not taken for two reasons:

- it is outside the claim's file surface, which says stop on breach;
- AGENTS.md #7 names two routes, a wrapper in `custom/` or the call site's `className`, and a global stylesheet override would be a third.

A `custom/` wrapper would have to be exported from `@object-ui/components`, because `layout` and `app-shell` import it by package name. That would widen a published surface. So the class goes at three call sites, and Clause-② stays `no`. The report puts the CSS route to the seat as an open question.

## Browser readings (before = `main` `0171c24`, after = this branch)

The console ran on Vite from this worktree, against `objectstack` `66d456d01` `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --fresh`, backend only, no edits). Chromium was at 1280 px wide, with the sidebar collapsed to icons. For **every** visible sidebar icon the probe read three things:

- `document.elementFromPoint` at its centre;
- the dead rows: 1 px rows along the icon's vertical centre line whose hit lands outside the row;
- a real mouse click at the centre: which element received it, and whether the route moved to the row's target.

The probe is a one-off script, not committed.

**A. Showcase, groups as authored.** The spec defaults `expanded` to `false`, so every group starts closed and the rail shows 2 icons.

| Icon | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Capability Map | own centre, navigates | own centre, navigates |
| Page Authoring | centre = Workspace group-label button, 16/31 dead rows, click toggled Workspace open, route unchanged | own centre, 0/31, navigates |

**B. Showcase, every group opened in the expanded sidebar, then collapsed through the app bar's toggle: 49 icons.** Before: 40 navigate and 9 do not. After: 49 of 49 have their own centre and 0 dead rows, and all navigate. These are the 9 that failed before, each with the label that took its click:

| Icon (the row above the group) | Centre hit before | Dead rows before |
|---|---|---|
| Page Authoring | Workspace group label | 16/31 |
| Settings | Data Model group label | 16/31 |
| Cascading Select | Data Slices (filters) group label | 24/31 |
| In-Review Tasks | Analytics group label | 16/31 |
| Task Overview | Authoring · Structured group label | 24/31 |
| Active Projects | Authoring · Visualizations group label | 16/31 |
| Work Map | Authoring · HTML group label | 16/31 |
| Command Center | Authoring · React group label | 16/31 |
| Renewals Pipeline · rollups … | Recent label (div) | 16/31 |

The 9 hidden labels read computed `pointer-events: auto` before and `none` after, with `opacity: 0` both times.

**C. A two-area app, with one row pinned: 7 icons.** The app was created at runtime in the `--fresh` temporary database with `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/probe_areas_app`, and no file was edited. Its areas are Work and Money. Work holds Projects, Tasks and a People group (Accounts, Contacts). Contacts was pinned through its row menu.

| Icon | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Work (area row) | own centre | own centre |
| Money (area row) | centre = Favorites label, 16/31 dead rows, click did not reach the row | own centre, the click reaches it |
| Contacts (pinned) | navigates | navigates |
| Projects | navigates | navigates |
| Tasks | centre = People group label, 16/31, route unchanged | navigates |
| Accounts | navigates | navigates |
| Contacts (in People) | centre = Recent label, 16/31, route unchanged | navigates |

Area label: `pointer-events: auto` before and after; it covers no row.

**Expanded sidebar, after.** Workspace label: a mouse click opens the group (My Work shows), a second click closes it, and focus plus Enter opens it again. Space closes it. The label reads `pointer-events: auto`, `opacity: 1`. A mouse click on the Recent label opens Recent: 0 rows, then 5.

## Tests

Two new pin files. Each renders the real `SidebarProvider` / `Sidebar` / `SidebarGroupLabel`, which are source-aliased in the root vitest config:

- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.iconModeLabelHitTest-12744.test.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.iconModeRecentLabel-12744.test.tsx`

Each file holds two pins:

1. **Collapsed to icons.** The fixed labels carry `pointer-events-none` under the variant the primitive hides them with. The expected token is derived from the primitive's own `…:opacity-0` token, so a primitive that changes its hiding condition turns the pin red. The test DOM computes no Tailwind, so the pin reads the class list; the browser readings above are the behavioural proof.
2. **Expanded.** No label carries an unconditional `pointer-events-none`. The group label toggles its group by user-event click and by Enter. The Recent label opens and closes Recent. This pin guards against a regression: it is green on `main` too, by design, since the expanded behaviour must not change.

**Ablations** ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` from `../objectstack`. Every mutation was confirmed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed), and every restore was proven (blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The subjects are imported from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Mutation | Pin 1 (collapsed) | Pin 2 (expanded) |
|---|---|---|
| `NavigationRenderer`: the class constant emptied (the `main` shape) | red | green |
| `NavigationRenderer`: the class made unconditional `pointer-events-none` | red | red |
| `UnifiedSidebar`: the class constant emptied | red | green |
| `UnifiedSidebar`: the class made unconditional | red | red |

## Local gates (all on `6a571d0`)

- Closure build: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/layout^...'`, then `--filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, `--concurrency=2`. Exit 0 both times; the second run: 28 of 28 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/layout --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. Both scripts echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `--listFiles` shows each new test in its package's test program.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/`: exit 0, `Test Files 132 passed (132)`, `Tests 982 passed (982)`.
- `eslint` on the four changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors. Every warning sits on an unchanged line; the new test files have none.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `0 new citation(s)`.

The rest of the farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

These are not filed from this PR. The two that read as defects are in the report for the seat to judge.

- **Icon mode cannot scroll.** At 1280×800 with every showcase group open, 29 of 49 rows sit below the fold. The primitive's `SidebarContent` is `overflow-hidden` in icon mode, and a mouse wheel over the rail left `scrollTop` at 0, so those rows cannot be reached until the sidebar expands.
- **Invisible focus stop.** Keyboard Tab in icon mode stops on a hidden group label: from Page Authoring, Tab lands on the Workspace label button at `opacity: 0`, and Enter then toggles a group the user cannot see. This fix leaves keyboard behaviour as it was, as the seat's shape asks.
- **Closed groups are out of reach in icon mode.** A closed group shows no rows and its label is invisible, so in icon mode its entries stay unreachable until the sidebar expands. The spec defaults `expanded` to `false`, so the stock showcase rail shows 2 icons. On `main`, a stray click on the row above happened to open a group; that accident is gone.
- **The home arm of `UnifiedSidebar` has no mount in the console.** That arm holds the Starred label. `HomeLayout`, `OrganizationsLayout` and `AiChatPage` set the navigation context to `home` but render no `UnifiedSidebar`. `ConsoleLayout`, its only mount, sets `app`. Its Starred label therefore has no reachable reading.
- **`SidebarNav` (`@object-ui/layout`).** It defaults to `collapsible="icon"`, and labels after the first sit under a separator below the previous group's last row. Reading the geometry, the overlap would be the lower part of that row, short of its centre. It has no mount in this repo, and nothing here measured it.

The work was done in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`.
